 Executive Education 
 
 
 
 Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is an academic prowess platform which prospects,
 prepares, and prospers every aspirant who is looking forward to seek professional education
 in various digital and managerial sectors. The Executive Education Programmes at IIM
 Lucknow campus are extensively arrayed to offer a high-class technological, professional and
 inclusive experience to all the working executives that, come from various nuances of
 different organisations.
 
 
 Incorporating technological advancements like e-learning, e-books and real-time navigation
 is the new mandate in executive education nowadays. The diverse programme design and
 consistent practice to refurbish the teaching style every academic year at IIM Lucknow,
 makes it unique and demanding amongst all the new age and traditional company setups.
 
 
 Every executive education programme offered by IIM Lucknow is crafted in a manner that
 addresses the needs of schedule, strategy and implementation process of every organisation.
 Programmes are aligned to required skills and competency frameworks envisioned by
 learners.
 
 
 To conquer the ongoing business challenges, IIM Lucknow provides the novelty of
 programmes that are planned and provided accordingly every year. The Executive Education
 platform is intended to widen the outlook and reinforce the managerial, professional and
 technological skills of working professionals all over the world.
 
 
 The global visualisation of IIM Lucknow is to impart world-class executive education to all
 the
 working professionals in different domains and provide them a tactical tool to uplift their
 professional personas.

The resolute spirit of selflessness, honesty and courage makes every Indian proud of the
 Indian
 armed forces. To keep this legacy framed forever, IIM Lucknow offers defence general
 management programmes for officers of the Indian Armed Forces almost every year that helps
 intensively to match the discipline of the Indian Army with the trends of the digital and
 managerial world. 

 A combined initiative by the Directorate General Resettlement, Ministry of Defence and Indian
 Institute of Management Lucknow (IIML), a six-month General Management Programme (GMP)
 for the Defence Officers is conducted at the Institute. 

 Read
 More 
 

 Objective 
 The objective of the programme is to facilitate smooth second career transition of the
 Defence
 Officers into
 the corporate world and familiarize them towards contemporary and emerging global
 management
 practices.
 

 Duration 
 The GMP for Defence Officers at IIML (Lucknow or NOIDA campus) is spread over duration of
 24 weeks
 and
 comprises five terms. Third term completion follows with a one week break. 

 Curriculum 

 The curriculum consists of 5 modules. In each module there are seven subjects offered.
 There are core
 courses
 in each of the first three modules and elective subjects are offered in module 4 and
 module 5. 

 The elective courses would be launched during the 4 th and 5 th 
 module. 
 This unique combination of compulsory and elective subjects, train them to develop a
 broad
 understanding of
 the subject matter and the issues central and critical to the success of business. 
 Faculty 
 Faculty from Indian Institute of Management Lucknow would deliver the program. 
 Pedagogy 
 A judicious mix of the following: 
 Case method of learning 
 Lectures 
 Exercises , Assignments 
 Group Projects & Presentations 
 Peer Discussions 
 Role Plays 
 Evaluation and Certification 
 The evaluation of academic performance is based on varying combinations of the
 following
 components: 
 Assignments, Quizzes, Class participation etc. 
 Project work 
 End-term examination 
 The Certificate will be awarded to such participants who in the judgment of the faculty
 have
 fulfilled all
 conditions and requirements for the same after the successful completion of all the five
 terms as per
 IIM Lucknow evaluation guidelines. 
 27th General Management Programme (24 weeks) for Defence Officers is scheduled
 from May 01 to
 Oct. 13,
 2023 at the Lucknow campus. 
 Phone: +91-0522 6696282/6288/6285
